name: quar-design
description: Design and animate in Quar Animator through its MCP server: a working loop that looks at every step, a design rubric, a motion guide and step-by-step recipes

interface.shortDescription: Design and animate 2D scenes in Quar Animator
interface.longDescription: Draws, animates and exports in your Quar Animator cloud projects the way a motion designer works: it plans the composition, builds it, looks at a picture of every step, fixes it, animates it with real timing and easing, checks the motion, and exports Lottie, GIF, PNG or SVG. Each step it saves is a version you can undo in the editor.
defaultPrompt: Make a 3-second bouncing logo in a new Quar project and give me a GIF.
Animate 'Make it move. Make it yours.' as kinetic type in Quar, one sentence per slide.
